Commentary.Commentary: After the initial havoc, Santner was the one who kept Bangladesh quiet in the middle overs, finishing with 3 scalps. Boult ended with 3 while Ferguson was pacy. The Kiwis will back themselves to gun down 232 but a few days ago, batting first against India, they had folded up for 157 at this very venue - with Kuldeep Yadav and Yuzvendra Chahal snaring 6 wickets. Do Bangladesh spinners have a chance? Join us back at 6.15 pm local (0515 GMT).

The start was excellent for the Kiwis. They blew the top and middle order away, taking 4 wickets inside Powerplay 1. Trent Boult and Matt Henry were the chief destroyers but then the tourists managed to battle it out and forge a partnership. Mohammad Mithun kept the innings going at one end and got a couple of good partners in Mehidy Hasan and Mohammad Saifuddin.

Well, after winning the toss and electing to bat, 232 is not what Mortaza would have expected. But he would have definitely HOPED that his side cross 200 from 94/6. At the moment, both teams would be happy with the situation.
OUT! Bowled off a yorker! Bangladesh do not play out their 50 overs. Mustafizur tries his best to dig it out but the ball takes the inside edge and then hits the stumps. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 232!
Finally connects. Backs away and slogs hard but straight to long off. Just a single.
WIDE. Gets well across his stumps and Boult fires it down the leg side. Gets punished.
Nothing on the Free Hit. A full toss, outside off, MM backs away but guides it straight to short third man!
FREE HIT TIME! Where can Mash hit this?
OOPS! NO BALL! Where did that come from? A high full toss, right at the batsman's head. Mortaza just about sways away in time.
Full and outside off, blocked towards mid off.
A full toss, flicked towards mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, Rahman flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Shorter in length, Mustafizur initially looks to play it but the decides to leave it. He is stuck in between those two and the ball goes to the keeper. There is a slight noise when it goes towards Latham. Ferguson appeal but the umpire turns it down. The replays show it flicked his shoulder on its way to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahman blocks it away.
Full on middle and leg, Mustafizur hits it to the fielder at mid on.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in. 17 balls left. Can the visitors play those out and get to 250?

OUT! Mithun's magnificent innings comes to an end. Good length delivery on middle, Mithun looks to heave it across the line but misses and the ball disturbs the leg pole. His heroic 62 has definitely given Bangladesh bowlers something to bowl at.
Backs away and hits it through the covers for a run.
Another leg bye, as the skipper misses out on the pull this time.
Down the leg side, Mash misses his tuck and the ball goes off his thighs towards square leg. A couple of leg byes taken.
Outside off, a yorker, Mortaza backs away, looking to dig it out but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Excellent yorker, on middle, Mortaza just about digs it out. The ball goes behind and just misses the leg stump. An alert Mithun calls his skipper through for a run.
FOUR! Cheeky from Mash! A short ball, outside off, coming at the body, Mortaza arches his back and guides it over the keeper to the third man fence!
Full and outside off, squeezed through the covers for a couple.
Very full, outside off, Mortaza wants to push and run to the off side but cannot beat point.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, pretty wide, played straight to point.
Lockie Ferguson is back on. 8-0-36-1 so far.
Full on the stumps, Mortaza starts his innings with a front foot defense.
In comes the skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza. His 100th international game as captain.

OUT!!! The partnership is finally broken. Flatter delivery outside off, Saifuddin looks to sweep but hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Martin Guptill there makes no mistake and holds onto the ball. A great innings from Saifuddin in the context of the game comes to an end. He departs for 41 and the 84-run stand is broken. His innings has kept Bangladesh in the game. But can they play out their 50 overs? Santner gets his 3rd of the evening.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Saifuddin hits it wide of long on and gets a couple.
Tossed up on off, Mohammad pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Flighted outside off, Mithun pushes it to cover for a single.

Great cricket all around. Flighted delivery outside off, Saifuddin sweeps it hard through mid-wicket. Trent Boult in the deep dives to his right and tries to collect the ball. He cannot do so and he runs behind the spill and dives again to stop it from going to the fence. He pulls it back and Matt Henry runs across to his left and does the mopping up. The batsmen take three runs.
Bizarre. Because of that dead ball, umpire Ravi thought that he had miscalculated. Held up play for a while, confirmed with the umpire upstairs and then continued the game.
FOUR! Full toss, around middle, Mithun swings it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.

5 PENALTY RUNS! The ball has indeed hit the helmet. Short and outside off, Mithun looked to cut but missed. The ball bounced in front of Latham and he fumbled. It then rolled back and almost hit the helmet behind, with Latham desperately diving to shove it away. The batsmen took a single but Tom's reaction seemed to indicate that the ball had hit the helmet. Yes, when referred upstairs, replays showed that his glove hit the ball after it hit the protection gear. The single is cancelled as the ball is ruled dead after it hits the helmet.
HAS THAT HIT THE HELMET? We could be in a situation of penalty here. Latham has misfielded and looks like the ball has rolled behind and hit the helmet kept there. The umpires are checking...
Full outside off, Saifuddin drives it wide of long on for a single.
Yorker length on middle, Saifuddin gets his bat down on time and keeps it out.
FOUR! Crunched. Back of a length outside off, Mithun cuts it brilliantly through point for a boundary. He timed it to perfection.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Full and outside off, reverse swept to short third man.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and miles outside off, going away with the angle, Saifuddin looks to sweep but misses. No wide signalled.
Short and outside off, spinning away, punched down to long off for a run.
Full and around middle, flicked through fine leg for a single.
On the pads, Mohammad flicks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Top edge but they will take it. Shorter of length, Saifuddin looks to pull but gets a top edge which flies over the keeper and onto the fence on a bounce for a boundary.
On the pads, Mithun flicks it away wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length, Saifuddin pulls it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, the southpaw leaves it alone.
Full around off, Saifuddin flicks it away to the fielder mid-wicket. He was looking for a single but Mithun sent him back.
Shorter in length, Saifuddin punches it towards the off side for single.
Flighted outside off, Mohammad hits it wide of point for a single.
Full on middle, Saifuddin nudges it to long on for a run.
On the pads this time, Mohammad flicks it away for a single.
Shorter around off, Mithun cuts it to the fielder at point. No run taken.
Flighted delivery outside off, Mithun looks to hit it on the off side but misses.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the ring now. Mitchell Santner is back on. 5-0-32-2 so far.
Full this time, Mohammad pushes it to the fielder at point.

3RD ODI FIFTY FOR MITHUN! Could not have come at a better time. Team in tatters but he sheds all fears. Just 73 balls taken, not a bad strike rate too. Gets there with a tuck through square leg for a single. Can he stay till the end and guide Bangladesh past 250? He will need partners too. 50-RUN STAND COMES UP.
Length delivery outside off, Mohammad makes room and plays it towards deep point and gets to the other end.
Once again on middle and leg, Mithun nudges it to the on side for a run.
On the pads, Saifuddin flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single.

Edge but safe. Henry starts with a back of a length delivery outside off. Saifuddin looks to guide it towards third man but the ball rises high onto him. He ends up edging it. The ball goes off the outside edge behind to the keeper. Tom Latham jumps and gets his finger tips to it but cannot hold onto it. Thr ball goes behind for a couple.
Matt Henry back on.
Length delivery on off, Mithun plays it to the fielder at point.
Shorter in length, Saifuddin pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Saifuddin flicks it but gets it off the inside edge of the bat onto his pad.
Full outside off, pushed away to the fielder at point.
Back of a length around off, Saifuddin pulls it to the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Mithun plays it with soft hands towards point and takes a quick single.
Around off, pushed towards point.

MIX-UP, SAFE! Full and around off, Mithun pushes it towards cover and sets off for a quick single. Saifuddin is not sure and sends him back. Neesham gets across, has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Mithun was a goner had that hit. Now, the batsmen take the overthrow.
Around middle, worked to the leg side for a run.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track, gets a short ball, looks to pull wildly but misses.
On a good length outside off, pushed straight to point.
On a good length around off, watchfully defended from the crease.
WIDE. He is bowling a wide almost every over now. Another one slips down the leg side, Mithun misses his flick.
Landed outside off, pushed through point where Henry Nicholls does well with a dive to his left.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a good length outside off, coming in, Mithun is cramped for room but manages to guide it towards third man for a couple.
Full and around off, driven through the covers for a single.
A short ball, pulled nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length, driven through mid off for one.
A short ball again, in line of the body, Saifuddin closes his eyes and plays the pull. Somehow, the ball goes through square leg and the batsmen cross over.
A short ball, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
On a good length outside off, pushed towards point where a misfield occurs but the batsmen do not run.
Trent Boult returns. 6-0-26-2 so far.
On the fifth stump line, the southpaw leaves it alone.
FOUR!!! Great shot. Saifuddin comes down the track and lofts it over the fhead of the cover fielder and the ball flies away to the boundary on a bounce.
Good length delivery on the pads, Saifuddin looks to flick but misses and the ball hits him high on the front pad.
Full on off, Saifuddin pushes it to the fielder at cover.
On a good length outside off, Saiduffin plays inside the line and is beaten.
Short and wide outside off, cut through the covers for a single. Mithun moves to 40 from 59 balls.
On the pads this time, Saifuddin flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length delivery on off, Mithun once again gets an outside edge of the bat and it goes away towards deep cover for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Mithun looks to defend but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to the fielder at slip cordon on a bounce.
Length delivery on off, Saifuddin gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! This one is too high. Shorter in length outside off, Saifuddin leaves it alone and the square leg umpire signals it as wide.
Bouncer from Ferguson. Saifuddin lets it go to the keeper.
On the pads, Mithun flicks it away on the on side for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Mithun pushes it to cover and keeps the strike.

Back of  length on the leg stump, Mithun looks to pull it but gets a glove on it and the ball goes towards the fine leg region. Lockie Ferguson there collects it and the batsmen come back for the second.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Saifuddin flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Saifuddin looks to guide it to third man but misses. The ball misses the outside edge by just a few inches.
Outside off, left alone again.
On the fifth stump line, Saifuddin leaves it alone.
Jimmy Neesham is back on. 3-0-11-0 so far.
Full on the pads, Saifuddin flicks ikt away to fine leg for a single.
Around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A yorker outside off, Mohammad looks to dig it out but misses.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a run.
In the air but safe. Saifuddin comes down the track, Lockie sees it and bowls it short. He goes for the pull but gets a top edge and the ball falls in the vacant sweeper cover region for a single.
Lockie Ferguson back into the attack..

DRINKS BREAK. Things keep getting difficult for the visitors. They are almost into their bowlers now but need to somehow bat out these 19 overs. Even 4 an over takes them to 220 which may not be match-winning but could be competitive.
FOUR!!! Short and wide by Santner, Mithun's eyes lit up looking at that. He goes onto his back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary.
On the pads, Saifuddin has no hesitation flicking it to mid-wicket for another single.
Loopy delivery on off and middle, Saifuddin keeps it away from danger.
Shorter on middle and leg, Mohammad flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Flighted outside off, Saifuddin pushes it to long on and gets off the mark.
Tossed up on middle, Mithun flicks it away to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Full and around off, Mohammad looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, left alone.
On a good length around middle, Saifuddin misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. Neesham appeals but that seemed to be going past the off stump.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
ANOTHER WIDE. Action replay of the previous delivery.
WIDE. Full and miles outside off, left alone.
Mohammad Saifuddin walks in next. Ahead of Mash.

OUT! In the air and taken! Santner strikes now and Bangladesh fall deeper into the hole. Full and outside off, Mehidy gets down and looks to play the paddle cum slog. But is too far from the ball and only manages to get a top edge. Initially, it looks like it will fall in no man's land but Jimmy Neesham runs across to his left from short fine leg and takes it nicely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Hasan tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Around off, defended towards cover.

Full and around middle, Mithun flicks it towards short mid-wicket. There is some confusion in the running and Mehidy is sent back. Kane Williamson fires in a throw to Santner but it bounces and hits Mehidy on his helmet as he dives back in. The bowler and fielder immediately ask Mehidy about his well-being and the response is a smile.
Gets across and laps it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers where the fielder makes a splendid stop diving to his left. The batsmen get back to their respective ends.
Around off, solidly blocked.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Flighted outside off, Mehidy gets down and mows a slog sweep over mid-wicket!
Fired in outside off, pushed towards cover.
Length delivery outside off, Mithun looks to drive it but gets beaten. Tight start by Neesham just 2 runs off his first over..
Good length delivery pitching on leg, Mithun looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Play and a miss. Back of a length outside off, Mithun goes for the pull but is early in his shot. He misses the ball and it goes to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Mehedy punches it to sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, Hasan defends it.
Starts with a full length delivery on the pads, Mohammad flicks it towards deep square leg and get to the other end.
James Neesham introduced now.
On the pads this time, Hasan glances it towards fine leg and gets a brace to finish the over.
Loopy delivery around off, Hasan watchfully blocks it.
Flighted on off and middle, Hasan keeps it out.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, flicked away towards square leg by Mithun to get a single.
Flighted around off, Mehedy pushes it to long off and gets to the other end.
Tossed up outside off, Mehedy pushes it to the fielder at point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FIVE WIDES! That has completely slipped out of the hand. Full and fired down the leg side, well outside the pitch, forget the batsman, the keeper cannot get to it. It is so wide. Races to the fine leg fence.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards third man for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, pushed behind point for a single.
WIDE. Way down the leg side, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a good length outside off, solidly defended.
FOUR! Classic batting. Full and outside off, this time Hasan comes forward and strokes it through the covers. So a wicket but 11 from it as well.
FOUR! Full and around middle, Mehidy comes down the track and heaves it over wide mid on for a boundary!
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Mehidy Hasan Miraz walks in next.

OUT! STUMPED OFF A WIDE! Sabbir has not made it back in time. The batsman comes down the track a touch too early and Santner spots it. Fires it outside leg and the batsman cannot adjust. He looks to flick but then slips. Tries to get back but struggles. Latham takes some time to collect and whips the bails off and that makes the umpire to go upstairs. Replays confirm that Sabbir's bat is late in getting in.
Is that the end of Sabbir? The Kiwis have appealed for a leg side stumping. Looks close...
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Comes down the track and pushes it through the covers for a single.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Spin time. Mitchell Santner into the attack.
Dropped short, pulled over mid-wicket for one.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, on a length, Mithun looks to defend but the ball seams back in with pace and beats his poke.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven straight to point.
Pushes this through point but straight to the fielder.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! What a shot. A length ball, around off, Mithun gets across and ramps it over the keeper towards fine leg!
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Around off, defended from the crease.
FOUR! Fine shot again. Half volley outside off, Rahman leans into the shot and drives it through the covers for another boundary!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Full and around off, Sabbir leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
1 run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, on a length, Rahman looks to punch but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Sabbir Rahman comes in at number 7, replacing Mahmudullah.

OUT! EDGED, DROPPED AND TAKEN! The visitors have lost half their side now. Full and outside off, Mahmudullah leans out to drive but gets a thick outside edge. It flies thick and fast to Ross Taylor at first slip but Rosco fumbles. However, luckily for him, the ball goes straight up in the air. He takes it in the second attempt. That partnership which was flourishing has been nipped in the bud.
WIDE. A bouncer now, the batsman ducks under it.
A length ball outside off, Mahmudullah feels for it but misses.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A short ball, around middle, Mithun looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball does not carry to fine leg and the batsmen take a single.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Nice shot. A length ball outside off, Mithun comes down the track and hammers it over mid off for a boundary!
Outside off, steered through point for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out and drives it through point for a couple.
A short one outside off, Mithun sways away from the line.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
152.6 KPH! Fire from Lockie. A short ball, around off, Mithun looks to defend but is beaten by pure pace.

IN THE AIR... JUST WIDE! We screamed but that would have been a bigger screamer had it been taken. A length ball, around middle, Mahmudullah clips it through square leg and it goes in the air. So does the fielder stationed over there. He flies to his right but the ball just eludes him. A single taken.
Pushes it to the off side, wants a single but is sent back.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
WIDE. A short ball, but own the leg side. Mahmudullah bails out. Good diving stop by Latham to his left.

DRINKS BREAK. New Zealand are well on top here. They have got rid off the top 4 Bangladeshi batsmen and are probably a wicket away from getting into the tail. The visitors are looking to rebuild and desperately need this Mithun-Mahmudullah stand to flourish and last long. This partnership is crucial for the visitors if they want to post a defendable total.
Cracking shot, lovely fielding. Full and outside off, MM leans and drives it through the covers but it is stopped nicely inside the ring.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Mahmudullah is in no rush and he defends it off his back foot.
On a length once again. The batsman gets behind it and keeps it away.
On middle and leg, Mahmudullah pushes it to the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length, Mahmudullah defends it from the crease.
Fuller this time. It is outside off, Mohammad looks to drive it but misses.
On middle and leg this time, the batsman flicks it away through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Inside edge but safe. Length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah looks to play it on the off side with an angled bat. The ball hits the inside edge and goes towards on side for a single.
Good bounce on this one. Pitches it on length, the ball rises on to the batsman, he guides it to the fielder at third man for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Mithun pushes it away to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery pitching on off, the ball comes in with the angle. Mithun defends it off his back foot.
Lockie Ferguson into the attack.
Back of a length, Mahmudullah blocks it away off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Mahmudullah pushes it away to the fielder at mid off.
Full outside off, guided to the fielder at third man with an angled bat for a single.
Full around off, Mithun drives it to the fielder at mid off.
On a length, this time it is on stumps. Defended.
Length delivery outside off, Mithun chooses not to disturb that one.
Colin de Grandhomme is the first bowling change of the day.
Once again a play and miss. Length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah looks to push it away but gets beaten.

NOT OUT! It is the shoulder! A good ball though. A short one, around middle, Mahmudullah looked to defend but the ball keeps on rising with the bounce. He looks to keep it out but the ball hits something and then deviates to the keeper. New Zealand appeal and umpire Ravi immediately gives it out. Mahmudullah though, does not waste even a second in reviewing it. Replays show us that the ball has missed the gloves and the bat and it has hit the shoulder. Hot Spot and Snicko confirm.
Caught behind! Or not? Mahmudullah has been given out but he straight away goes upstairs. He is very confident he has not hit it his bat.
Length delivery on the fifth stump line, Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Bouncer. On middle and leg, Mahmudullah ducks underneath it.
Good length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah looks to push it away but gets beaten.
Full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah leans and drives it through point. The fielder gets his hand to it and parries it behind point. Two runs taken.
On a length, Mithun keeps it out to see off the over.
Back of a length on the stumps, Mithun blocks it away off the back foot.
On a good length outside off, shouldered arms to.
On a length, Mithun defends it off his back foot.
Length delivery on off, Mahmudullah looks to defend it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery around off, Mahmudullah blocks it away.
POWERPLAY 2 TIME. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

FOUR!! Full toss on the pads, Mithun flicks it fine towards the fine leg region and the ball goes away to the fence.  Easy pickings this for Mithun. That ends Powerplay 1. 50/4. Do we need to say who is on top?

One more LBW shout. Prodigious swing from Boult. Very full, around middle, Mithun falls over in his attempt to flick. Is hit on the pads and up goes Boult. But the appeal is turned down. Probably missing leg again.
On a good length outside off, shoulderd arms to.
Full and straight, Mahmadullah defends it with soft hands and takes a quick single as the ball goes to the wide of mid off on  the right.
A bouncer now, around middle, Mahmudullah ducks.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Outside off, played behind point for a run. 3 runs and a wicket from the over, Henry's figures read 5-1-25-2.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, Mithun looks to drive but is beaten all ends up.

Great ball to welcome the new man in. Pitching on middle and off, the ball jags back in. Mahmudullah looks to defend it but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards square leg. The batsmen take a single.
Mohammad Mahmudullah is the next man in.

OUT! And then there were four! Boy o boy o boy. New Zealand are all over Bangladesh like a rash. A short ball now, Soumya instinctively goes for the pull but the bounce does him in. Gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. The ball has gone nowhere and Henry gets forward and takes it comfortably. Bangladesh are a sorry 43/4...
Full and around off, driven straight to cover.
Mohammad Mithun walks in at number 5, replacing Rahim.

OUT! Chops it on! Bangladesh are three down in Powerplay 1. Lack of footwork from Rahim. Clearly, the hit on the head has shaken him. On a good length, outside off, Rahim looks to punch it through the off side but does not move his feet. Is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and as a result, just drags it back onto the stumps.
On a length once again, Rahim blocks  it out with a straight bat.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahim leaves it alone.
Another short one. This time Rahim ducks underneath it.

A bit of a delay here and rightly too. All the Kiwis are around Rahim, checking on his well-being and the physio is out in the middle. He looks shaken a bit, taking a few gulps of water. Hope everything is fine.

OUCH! A brilliant bouncer from Boult. It rises onto Rahim. He looks to play it at first but then looks to get out. The ball hits him on his helmet and lobs to the fielder at cover. There is a stifled appeal but the umpire turns it down.

Good length delivery outside off, Sarkar looks to play it on the off side with a horizontal bat but gets an inside edge. Luckily for him it does not chop onto his stumps and goes to the on side for a single.
FOUR!!! Rahim taking the charge. Length delivery outside off, Rahim comes down the track and hits it through the vacant mid off region for a boundary.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Rahim defends it.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
SIX!!! Wow what a shot. Good length delivery on off,  Soumya rocks onto his back foot and heaves it over mid-wicket for a maximum. The sound it made after connection was just so crisp.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahim cuts it to point and takes a single.
Full on middle and leg, Rahim flicks it towards mid-wicket. Guptill there fives to his left and saves runs for his side.

MASSIVE INSIDE EDGE! The Kiwis lose their sole review. A lovely delivery from Boult, full and around off, swinging in a long way, Soumya looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. To the naked eye, it looks pretty straight and plumb in front. But umpire Ravi looks very calm and then shakes his head. Williamson asks his bowler and then his keeper and eventually, signals for the 'T'. Replays straightaway indicate bat and Snickometer confirms.
A review taken! Where was the impact? Was there bat? Latham reckons Sarkar is plumb LBW. Let's see...
Goes back in his crease and blocks.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Banged in short, outside leg, Sarkar swivels and pulls it over fine leg!
FOUR!! Too full this time by Boult asking to be punished. It is pitched on middle and leg. Sarkar flicks it uppishly over square leg for a boundary.
Full and a hint of away swing. Soumya hits it to the fielder at mid off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, on a good length, watchfully blocked out.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and straight, pushed towards mid on.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Cleaned him up! Bangladesh lose two quickly. Both openers dismissed to both the opening bowlers. On a good length outside off, going away, Das looks to defend but like the Tamim dismissal, here too, the batsman is squared up. Misses his defense and the ball hits the top of off.
Once again Boult gets good swing. Full and it is shaping away from the southpaw. Soumya flicks it away to mid on.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Sarkar defends it.
Good length delivery, the ball hurries onto Soumya. He does well to keep it out.
FOUR! MAJESTIC! Full and outside off, Sarkar leans and drives it with the outswing through the covers!
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket where a half stop parries the ball towards mid on.

Another LBW appeal. Turned down again. Williamson looks at his bowler for the review. He indicates that it is too high. Hot Spot indicates a mark though, meaning an inside edge. The ball was pitched around leg and came back in. Das missed his flick and the ball went off his thigh pads towards third man. A single taken, leg bye signalled.
FOUR! SLAM! Too short and too wide, outside off, Soumya crashes this through the covers. No point chasing those. Spoils what would have been a terrific over.
Full again, in line of the sticks, pushed back to the bowler.

Ahh.... full and straight, LD somehow gets his bat down in time. That was heading straight for the stumps and was plumb LBW. Now, it rolls off the inside edge towards fine leg and the batsmen take a single.
On a good length this time, LD gets right behind it and blocks it out.
Outside off, on a length, Liton feels for it but misses.
LBW appeal, turned down. Full and down the leg side, a bit too straight, Das misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Perhaps going down.
Better from Boult. Good length delivery outside off, Sarkar tries to push it away to the off side but misses. Good over from Boult, four runs and a wicket.
FOUR!!! Great way to get off the mark. Shorter in length by Boult, Soumya picks the length early and rocks onto his back foot. He pulls it away hard over square leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on the stumps, Soumya defends it off his front foot with a straight bat.
Great ball to welcome Sarkar to the crease. Yorker on middle, Soumya does well to get his bat down in time and keep it out.
Soumya Sarkar walks out at number 3.

OUT!!! What a ripper! Pitching on middle and leg, the ball initially looks like it is coming in but then straightens. Iqbal tries to flick it but then gets squared up. The ball tickles off his outside edge and it goes straight to the keeper. Tom Latham behind the stumps takes an easy catch and a big blow for Bangladesh. Their best batsman is back in the pavillion.
Hint of away swing straightaway for Boult. The ball is pitched outside off and the ball goes away to the keeper as Iqbal leaves it away.
Trent Boult to bowl with the second new ball.
On a length, Liton keeps it out with another defense.
First ball to Liton and Henry bowls it on a length. Das starts his innings carefully with a back foot defense.
Length delivery outside off, Tamim guides it to third man and takes a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Iqbal defends it from his crease.
Oops... Henry is still not looking comfortable. Pulls out halfway through his runup.

Better from Henry. Good length delivery outside off, Tamim keep his bat on the off stump as the ball goes away to the keeper. Henry looks a bit uncomfortable out in the middle and it looks like it is his hamstring.
FOUR! Poor delivery to start the innings. Henry starts with a length delivery on the pads, Iqbal has no problem facing that. He just flicks it away deftly towards fine leg for a boundary.

The anthems are done and dusted and we are all set to begin. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das walk out to the middle to open the innings for Bangladesh. Matt Henry will bowl the first over for New Zealand with the first new ball.
Time for the National Anthems. Bangladesh's one first.

Kane Williamson says he also would have opted to bat first. Whether he feels the pitch is different than the game against India, Williamson feels it is as there is less grass. Feels it could have been rolled a little bit. On the team news, he says Tim Southee and Todd Astle miss out.

Mashrafe Mortaza says it looks like a good wicket to bat first. On the series win against Windies, the skipper says it was a great series and they did well in all departments. Says they are playing about 2-3 spinners in the game.
Toss -  Mashrafe Mortaza calls heads and heads it is. He has opted to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - Mark Richardson says it looks like a batting paradise. States the groundsman has verti-cut the grass. Explains verti-cut leaves only the leaves away. States it is a rock hard surface and the batsmen will enjoy it. Ends by saying he expects a good game of cricket to start the ODI series.

Hello and welcome to the first of 3 ODI match series between New Zealand and Bangladesh. The hosts come into this ODI series after a 4-1 loss at home against India. These are the final 3 ODI matches for the Kiwis before the World Cup and they would look to get their combination right and like to head into the tournament in the summer with a series win. Coming to the visitors, this is their first tournament of the year and they come into this one with an ODI series win over Windies at home.  They would like to continue that winning momentum and win their first ODI series in New Zealand. Like the Kiwis, Bangladesh too will look to get their combination right before the World Cup. Both teams eager to start the series on a winning note but only one will succeed. Join us for the start of this exciting series opener in a while. Stay tuned for updates...
